fails_if: `compile_edition_splits` stops rebinding the '2007-12-31' edition's rows to the declared split variant, so both 2007 editions stay in the flow variant and conflict

sources.description: Variant 2 of register 1 delivers SHARED (variable 5) twice for 2007: edition '2007' (CVID 20, integer) and edition '2007-12-31' (CVID 21, string).

note: Without the split, the two 2007 editions of one native variant conflict (`conflicting_occurrence_facts`); the split's own variant takes the named edition, and SHARED keeps one state in each variant with its own type.
